mythos_catalog.name: War of the Philippines TCG Mythos

mythos.name: BATHALA
mythos.effect: Divine Presence: All allied cards gain +2 Attack and +3 Defense while this card is on the field.
mythos.lore: The supreme deity of ancient Tagalog creation, Bathala watches the field as keeper of balance between sky, sea, and earth.

mythos.name: MAYARI
mythos.effect: Deity's Favor: Pay 1 Kalayaan to restore 5 Life to an allied unit.
mythos.lore: Mayari, guardian of the moon, guides night marches and lends quiet strength to wounded defenders.

mythos.name: TALA
mythos.effect: Deity's Favor: Pay 1 Kalayaan to restore 5 Life to an allied unit.
mythos.lore: Tala is the bright pathfinder whose star-fire reveals a safe route through a contested archipelago.

mythos.name: AMIHAN
mythos.effect: Windborne Presence: Flying Mythos units gain +1 Move while Amihan remains on the field.
mythos.lore: Amihan is the northeast wind, arriving cool and clear over the islands after the rains have passed.

mythos.name: BAKUNAWA
mythos.effect: Eclipse Swimmer: When summoned, puts enemy non-water units to Sleep for 1 turn.
mythos.lore: The moon-eating serpent coils beneath Philippine waters, dragging light into the deep when it rises.
